snippet.title: Unseal - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Developer Overview Trailer for Unseal, a third-person action-adventure puzzle horror game developed by The Unseal Team. Players will traverse a surreal nightmare world to solve puzzles, avoid monsters, and embark on a grand cosmic horror adventure. Unseal is coming soon to PC (Steam).
